clips.title: The story
paras: Underground Assault is an Alliance quest offered by Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. Tasked with aiding the displaced gnomes, adventurers venture into the Deadmines to salvage an intact power core from a goblin shredder. This stolen component is destined to power drilling machines intended to spearhead the liberation of Gnomeregan.

Following the catastrophic fall of Gnomeregan to the primitive troggs, surviving gnomish tinkerers have been forced into exile across Khaz Modan and Stormwind. Rather than wallowing in defeat, engineers like Shoni the Shilent are already devising mechanical operations to breach their lost home. The primary obstacle is the dense, subterranean rock surrounding the technocratic city, requiring massive tunneling engines known as gyrodrillmatic excavationators. Lacking the necessary localized power grids in human lands, the gnomes have turned their sights to an unlikely and volatile alternative: goblin heavy machinery operating in the criminal underworld.

Deep within the twisting shafts of the Deadmines in Westfall, Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood employs goblin engineers to manufacture war machines, including a fully operational goblin shredder. Shoni directs Alliance operatives to infiltrate this foundry, destroy or dismantle the lumbering automaton, and recover its specialized heart—the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket. By commandeering the potent goblin power supply, the exiled gnomes gain the raw mechanical output needed to bore through the subterranean perimeter and launch a counteroffensive to reclaim Gnomeregan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, friend.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
